notes.title: Minor release.
notes.content:
Small fixes and possible to remap game controllers. 

So if you keys is wrong, please remap it again. 

Same if your game run in 30fps, and was run 60fps fine, just change it again.  This game does no longer uses eventuelly frameskips, so if the game run to slow (this should not happens on those machines we have today), you can set it to 30fps.

This game was originally designed after 30/60fps and not after systemtimer (unlike my other games did). But its not a issue in a game like its this.

notes.title: Steam Deck update
notes.content: Now fully playable on Steam Deck!

notes.title: This game goes DRM Free!
notes.content:
From today, the game has removed the DRM, that is include Steam DRM (Im do forgot to change the version date to today).

There is something to remember:

1. If you want to support me, purchase the game and/or the DLC directly here on steam and only on steam! 

2. Im do not get any payment from any keysellers at all, but im will also do NOT deactivate any keys of those. 

3. Now im also have removed the DRM as the game is now a quite old.....

notes.title: About unused keys.
notes.content:
Im is sorry. sorry!

Im did wrote im would revoke any unsold keys that was sold from a contain site (im have deleted the news). But a closer look about those, its was really just from a single bundle and a another bundle with two other games (which is now free, so no reason to revoke them at atll).

So: Im will NOT revoke ANY keys at all! So fell free whatever you want do with them! Im will NOT revoke them. Im is 100% complete sorry for this drama and is a 100% mistake from my side!

This is NOT your fault, its was a publisher fault. This is a issue between me and the previous publisher and not you.

PS. Im have no plans to request more keys at all and those that is out here. im do still have few comply of keys left.

notes.title: Maze and Puzzles is now seperated as own game!
notes.content:
as im wrote and actuelly forgot it. Im have today now seperated the maze and puzzles villages totally, because they was more fells like own games with different rules.

Maze was more made for kids and those that like regular mazes, which was no focus on puzzles, while the normal games was focus on puzzles.

You can do still switch between maze and puzzle without exist and reenter the game again by enter this code in the main village:

[i]Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, Map, Menu.[/i]

Yes, the code is based on a famous cheat code by a well known japanse company! The above can been invoked by default with the arrowkeys+z+x).

notes.title: Another bug fix Release today.
notes.content:
Im have just fixed some Alt-Enter issues as well lower resolutions should also works again. its might have bugged out in some lower resolutions for some users.

This is my last update until im get my ownership for my game back again (excpt if found other important bugs).

So im do try to fix most issues found in the reviews. Positive as well Negative.

notes.title: All doors now open!
notes.content: Im have recently Open all doors to all levels. The star requirements locks do stay, so some doors to later levels is still require some star progress in that village.
